children: Statistics Canada releases 3Q GDP data on Monday, and Bank of Canada Gov. Tiff Macklem says the data would weigh on the December rate decision. The BOC forecast 2% annualized growth for 3Q, although the data agency's monthly GDP-industry data point to 1.3% expansion in the July-to-September period. Macklem tells reporters the monthly GDP figures point to downside risks for its 3Q projection. Macklem says BOC officials will be focused on what the monthly GDP-by-industry data for September indicates for activity. "What's the handoff to 4Q? What does it tell us about what we think might be coming?," Macklem says. Weak growth has persuaded some economists to suggest the BOC might want to hold off on a December rate hike. (paul.vieira@wsj.com; @paulvieira)
